name: Charlie MJ DevOps Explorer
notes: Bug-fix release: corrected dashboard module syntax caused by await inside deleteDocumentation and malformed Learning resource newline literals
Added Category and Subcategory to Official Documentation records and upgraded the registry to JSON schema v2
Official Documentation JSON now includes category taxonomy, tags, and the GitHub Actions example
Learning cards can link existing Labs, Projects, Goals and Roadmaps through Add Additional Details
Linked Learning cards are visible from existing Lab, Project, Goal and Roadmap records through Additional Details
Labs and Projects now support JSON Import and Export
Official Documentation selection in Learning now has search and multi-select instead of a full unfiltered list
Learning cards now have an Open detail view
Workspace schema migrated to v5 while preserving existing data and features
